answer: The lotus of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A terrace of per-task receipts records who did what, and the mesa of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
